message:
## Vulnerability Digest

Fresh sweep completed for the 24-hour window ending 2026-06-07 05:10 IST, using the monitored product list in Products.txt. One high-confidence relevant finding was confirmed for the monitored list: active exploitation of a SolarWinds Serv-U denial-of-service vulnerability. One WordPress plugin issue is included separately as a possible match needing review because it affects a WordPress plugin that was not named in the product list.

**Finding 1: SolarWinds Serv-U unauthenticated denial-of-service vulnerability reported as exploited**

- Product: SolarWinds Serv-U
- Issue: CVE-2026-28318
- Severity: High / CVSS 7.5, as stated by SolarWinds
- Description: SolarWinds says Serv-U can be crashed by specially crafted unauthenticated POST requests using `Content-Encoding: deflate`, causing denial of service. BleepingComputer reported on June 5, 2026 that CISA had flagged the issue as exploited in the wild and added it to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.
- Why it appears relevant: The monitored list includes SolarWinds. Serv-U is a SolarWinds managed file transfer / FTP server product, so this maps to the monitored SolarWinds product family even though Serv-U is not listed separately.
- Sources: SolarWinds advisory: https://www.solarwinds.com/trust-center/security-advisories/cve-2026-28318; BleepingComputer: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/cisa-hackers-now-exploit-solarwinds-serv-u-flaw-to-crash-servers/amp/

**Possible matches needing review**

**Everest Forms Pro WordPress plugin remote code execution under active exploitation**

- Product: WordPress ecosystem plugin, Everest Forms Pro
- Issue: CVE-2026-3300
- Severity: Critical / CVSS 9.8, as stated by Wordfence
- Description: Wordfence and BleepingComputer report active exploitation of an unauthenticated PHP code injection flaw in Everest Forms Pro versions 1.9.12 and earlier, allowing arbitrary code execution on affected WordPress sites that use the vulnerable plugin and feature.
- Why review is needed: The monitored list includes WordPress, but it does not specifically list Everest Forms Pro. Treat this as relevant only if that plugin is deployed.
- Sources: Wordfence: https://www.wordfence.com/blog/2026/06/attackers-actively-exploiting-critical-vulnerability-in-everest-forms-pro-plugin/; BleepingComputer: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/critical-everest-forms-pro-flaw-exploited-to-take-over-wordpress-sites/

**Reviewed but excluded**

- Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager CVE-2026-20245: fresh and credible, but the monitored Cisco scope is Cisco Nexus, Cisco UCS, and Cisco Fabric Extender; the advisory did not map to those products.
- HTTP/2 Bomb / CVE-2026-49975 affecting nginx, Apache HTTP Server, and Microsoft IIS: relevant to monitored products, but the primary disclosure was earlier than this 24-hour window.
- Visual Studio Code token-theft issue: relevant to Visual Studio Code, but initial public reporting occurred before this 24-hour window.
- MongoDB-family terms, including MongoDB server, mongod, mongos, Atlas, Ops Manager, drivers, connectors, and official components: no credible in-window matching vulnerabilities were confirmed.

Closing note: Immediate review is recommended if SolarWinds Serv-U is deployed, especially if internet-exposed. Also check whether Everest Forms Pro is present on any WordPress sites before prioritizing that possible match. No other fresh, credible, product-matched vulnerabilities were confirmed for the monitored list in this 24-hour window.
